name: Sanctions & coercion
value: EU 22nd package pending; US listings 18–19 Nov
summary: EU's 22nd Russia package still pending, aimed for Christmas; US listed Hezbollah and IRGC finance networks 18 Nov
state: EU foreign policy chief Kallas said on 16 Nov the 22nd Russia package would be presented in the coming days, with adoption targeted by Christmas; searches to 23 Nov found no formal adoption (UNN). On 18 Nov the US Treasury designated a Hezbollah-affiliated charity and a gold and cash smuggling network linked to Iran's IRGC-Qods Force, and on 19 Nov amended a licence for the sale of Lukoil International (OFAC). No major economy has been cut off from payment systems, so Watch holds.
for_you: Firms trading with Russia, Iran or their intermediaries face shifting compliance rules and secondary-sanction exposure. Official guidance comes from UK OFSI and the US Treasury's OFAC.
rubric_hit: Major new packages pending and secondary-sanction risk = Watch; no payment-system cut-off

sources.title: UNN — The EU will present its 22nd package of sanctions against Russia in the coming days: Kallas
US Treasury — Operation Economic Outcast targets Iran's proxy networks

why: Sanctions are now a frontline weapon; secondary sanctions and asset seizures fragment global finance and trade.
drivers: Russia/Iran sanctions packages, secondary sanctions, frozen-asset decisions, export controls.

rubric.alert: Major economy cut off from payment systems, or large-scale seizure of sovereign assets.

rubric.normal: No major new sanctions packages this week.
